def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    pedestrians = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    storefronts = image_patch.find("storefront")
    pavement = image_patch.find("pavement")

    pedestrian_storefront_distance = [(p, s, distance(p, s)) for p in pedestrians for s in storefronts]
    pedestrian_pavement_distance = [(p, pav, distance(p, pav)) for p in pedestrians for pav in pavement]

    pedestrian_storefront_sorted = sorted(pedestrian_storefront_distance, key=lambda x: x[2])
    pedestrian_pavement_sorted = sorted(pedestrian_pavement_distance, key=lambda x: x[2])

    return [x[0] for x in pedestrian_storefront_sorted + pedestrian_pavement_sorted]
